summary.id: Salat sunah melengkapi kebiasaan ibadah tanpa menggantikan prioritas lima salat wajib.
summary.en: Voluntary prayer enriches worship without replacing the priority of the five obligatory prayers.

text.id: Salat sunah melengkapi kebiasaan ibadah tanpa menggantikan prioritas lima salat wajib.
text.en: Voluntary prayer enriches worship without replacing the priority of the five obligatory prayers.

text.id: Dahulukan salat wajib dan pelajari salat sunah secara bertahap.
text.en: Prioritize obligatory prayers and learn voluntary prayers gradually.

text.id: Kenali waktu yang dianjurkan dan waktu larangan sebelum menyusun kebiasaan.
text.en: Know encouraged and prohibited times before forming a routine.

text.id: Tahajud adalah salah satu salat malam yang dapat dilakukan sesuai kemampuan.
text.en: Tahajjud is one form of night prayer that may be performed according to ability.

body.en: This draft awaits content and language review. Confirm practice-affecting details with a trusted instructor.
